mostWorthwhile.text: The red-cell sequence was most worthwhile: it connected low oxygen, a kidney signal and marrow production across body systems.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the new skin cells to the body felt somewhat repetitive after the preceding result had already shown their movement upward.

surprise.text: The kidney’s role in signaling red-cell production was an interesting connection to marrow.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the offered combinations made most of the sequence predictable and left few meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter if it offered more connections between body systems and more meaningful choices; this chapter’s renewal examples were clear but mostly sequential.
